scope: Analysis-only scientific direction review, not a claim of universal impossibility.

scientific_outputs: Explicit full-C bounded joint-distinguishability abstraction contract; standard specification, not new theorem.

input_preservation.scope: Identified read-only input files with prior recorded hashes; not whole workspace.

remaining_scientific_gaps: precise increment beyond closest prior fragment
gate_scope: Analysis-only rejection exception; no venue, execution, confirmation, promotion or submission gates are asserted passed.
